note: Generated from the registries by scripts/build_arena_data.py. The Arena renders; it never scores.

tracks.metric_focus: entity accuracy, ambiguity retention, false-merge rate
Recall@K, nDCG, citation validity, study-design classification
edge provenance rate, measured/predicted separation, enrichment reproducibility
risk recall, severe false-negative rate, evidence sufficiency
artifact completeness, re-run success, claim calibration

gates.description: severe false negatives are cases where a high-risk signal was present in the gold label and the run did not surface it; the threshold is zero for critical-severity cases

a citation that does not resolve, or resolves to a source that does not contain the quoted text, is fabricated; the threshold is exactly zero, because a system that invents citations cannot be trusted on anything else it reports
the run must produce an artifact that re-runs to the same result under the same four version axes

stating a clinical efficacy conclusion on evidence that is only computational prediction is the failure this project exists to prevent; it is a gate rather than a low score because it is a category error, not a quality shortfall

aggregation.formula: n / sum(1 / s_i) over the eight dimensions
aggregation.note: dominated by the weakest dimension, so a system must be good at provenance and safety together, not good at one and absent at the other
